downstreamNotes: Naive Core is a dark-first design system distilled from naive-ui official dark theme. Full coverage: 95 naive-ui components + atoms (96 total). Tokens are preserved verbatim (e.g. --primaryColor instead of --bg-brand). Components use the .ds-* class prefix. UI Kits are showcases (max-width 1184px) — do not copy as page templates; read preview/component-*.html for clean component markup and compose your own outer grid at the consumer canvas size.
